input: Find a local boxing gym for beginners

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the user's city or neighborhood is essential to actually identifying gyms that are geographically accessible to them.
Whether this is for the user themselves, a child, or someone else changes the type of gym needed — youth programs vs. adult classes vs. mixed.
The user's goal for boxing (fitness/cardio, competitive fighting, self-defense, or just trying it out) determines which gym type and program style is the right fit.
Monthly membership costs vary widely; knowing the user's budget ceiling narrows down realistic options and avoids recommending gyms they cannot afford.
Preferred training days and times affect which gyms are practical — a gym with no evening or weekend beginner classes may be useless regardless of quality.
Some beginners want a supportive, non-competitive atmosphere; others want a serious, fight-focused environment. This shapes which gym culture is the right match.
Knowing what 'found the right gym' looks like — e.g., visited in person, signed up for a trial class, or just has a shortlist — determines how far the plan needs to go.

gold.taskTitle: Find a local beginner-friendly boxing gym
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate a boxing gym nearby that is suitable for beginners to join and start training.
